title: Instagram's AI Is Now in Your DMs | 3 AI Tools You Missed #1 📩
description:
Instagram now has Meta's Muse AI agent right inside your DMs: share a post with it and ask it to add that place to your trip plan, or catch up on chats you missed. It is rolling out on iOS and Android in the US, Canada, Mexico, Japan and Singapore. Also new: Pinterest lets parents turn down how much AI-generated content their teens see, and Claude can install the apps it builds as real Mac and Windows apps (beta, on every plan including Free).
Full AI news every Sunday: AI News This Week on our channel.

Which one would you try first? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop: 3 AI Tools You Missed #2 drops next Thursday.

Source: TechCrunch, "Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs" (November 24, 2026) + Engadget (November 24, 2026); Pinterest Newsroom, "Helping families navigate controls for teens on Pinterest" (November 23, 2026) + TechCrunch (November 24, 2026); Anthropic Help Center, "Install an artifact as an app" via TestingCatalog and Unite.AI (November 24-25, 2026)
